# LLMs.txt for Leski Karuchka
# https://llmstxt.org/

# Overview
Leski Karuchka (Лески Каручка) is a local ride-hailing app for ordering horse-drawn carriages in Levski, Pleven Province, Bulgaria (postal code 5900). Users can order a carriage online, track their driver live on a map, and pay with cash, card, or online — all at fixed transparent prices.

# Core Services
- City transport within Levski and surrounding villages (Bulgarene, Asenovtsi, Obnova, Gradishte)
- Transport to bus station and railway station
- Live driver tracking via GPS
- Fixed upfront pricing — no surprises
- Multiple payment methods: cash, card in-carriage, online

# How to Use
1. Register or log in at leskikaruchka.com/auth/login
2. Enter pickup address and destination
3. See exact price before ordering
4. Track driver arrival live on map
5. Pay your preferred way after the ride

# Key Facts
- Average wait time: ~5 minutes in Levski city
- Operating hours: 07:00 – 23:00, every day
- Service area: Levski (5900) and surrounding villages in Pleven Province
- 18 verified drivers, 12 company partners
- Currency: EUR (€)
- Business address: bul. Bulgaria №58, Levski 5900, Bulgaria
- Phone: +359 89 000 5900
- Email: info@leski-karuchka.bg

# Pricing
- Base fare: 2.00 €
- Per kilometer: 1.10 €
- Per minute: 0.28 €
- Minimum fare: 3.00 €
- City ride examples: ~3.10 € – 3.60 €

# No-Go Areas
- This site does NOT provide medical, legal, or financial advice.
- User accounts and ride data are handled per GDPR and Bulgarian data protection law.
- All prices are estimates; final price is shown in-app before confirming the ride.
